BiblicalUsage: yᵉrach is the word the Bible uses when it means a month. In Ezra 6:15, this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, and it appears again in Daniel 4:29.
TheologicalSignificance: The house is finished in the month Adar, and I take yᵉrach as God's timing written into the calendar.
